name: Sporeback
telegraph: Stops walking and leans back; the green nozzle under the cap is the launch point.
counterplay: Wide gaps between the slow spores. Sidestep after the pause.
projectile: Spore clump; no poison cloud or damage-over-time assumed.
notes: Live stats and loot are defined in scripts/enemies/enemies.gd; staged design values are authoring references.
